newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ayala Corp unit FRN raised to US$90 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp unit FRN raised to US$90 mln.

text.p: Ayala Corp unit AC International Finance Ltd's five-year floating rate notes issue has been increased to US$90 million from US$75 million due to oversubscription, arranger BT Asia said Monday.
The notes were issued at par to float at 90 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 105 basis points.
Ten international banks in addition to the arranger and co-arrangers joined the syndication.
Chinatrust Commercial Bank, Credit Lyonnais, Development Bank of Singapore and IBJ Asia are co-arrangers.
Signing is set for Tuesday. The payment date is Friday.
